_readme: Hand characters for build/skin_hands.py (hands v1). Each is a recipe applied to every passing master pose: skin (target midtone hex, or null = the master's own), sleeve (target hex for the cream linen sleeve, or null = as is), jewellery per side, rendered in 3D by build/hand_jewellery3d.py (hands v3): {type: ring, stone: aqiq|diamond} at the ring-finger anchor, {type: wrist, style: tennis | [bangle materials: glass_red, glass_green, gold]} at the bracelet anchor, overlay (texture masked to the back of the hand), left_variant (also bake a mirrored left hand with the 'left' jewellery, for characters whose hands differ).

player-boy._note: The master set as is: plain white linen rolled sleeve.

player-girl._note: Dusty-pink rolled sleeve, three thin bangles on each wrist: red glass, green glass, gold.

player-girl-eid.pending: mehndi overlay texture not made yet (to come from ChatGPT); set overlay.texture to bake

nani._note: Cast, 'Jewellery (corrected 24 Sept)' and sheet v2: no bangles; right: red aqiq ring in a plain yellow gold bezel, thin diamond tennis bracelet; left: round solitaire diamond in a six-claw yellow gold setting. Warm, unsaturated skin, a touch deeper than the player's; deep-red sleeve. The hand shape is the child's master: code can't age it.
